decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The premises shall not be used for the sale of food for consumption off the premises other than confectionery.

Condition : 6 - Details of the cycle racks shown on drawing BREN223DS04-C31, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and thereafter be permanently provided and maintained, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 7 - It is considered that this application for the sub-division of the existing unit, would not be detrimental to the appearance of the original unit, the character of the street scene or to the amenities of the area.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is generally compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.  It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
description: Creation of additional unit and 2 separate entrances, by sub dividing unit and removing current main entrance to building.
